recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body profile shot of a person in sporty streetwear walking across an asphalt lot against a corrugated metal wall, featuring large 3D-extruded numerals in the background and distressed sans-serif text at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's red jacket provides the primary color pop against a neutral gray background
Large 3D numerals overlap the background wall but sit behind the subject's head
The diagonal line of the subject's stride mimics the perspective of the ground plane
Bottom text is anchored to the asphalt surface with a subtle perspective tilt
coreInvariants: High-contrast red, white, and blue color palette on the clothing
Industrial corrugated texture of the background wall
3D extrusion of the background numerals pointing downward and to the left

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body subject positioned slightly left of center, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red jacket serves as the primary focal point due to its high saturation.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the red jacket, follows the subject's stride down to the shoes, moves across the bottom text, and finishes on the large background numerals.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space provided by the neutral corrugated wall on the right side.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral grays and whites from the background and asphalt.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red used in the jacket, stripes, and hair.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep blue stripes and black shadows in the 3D text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation on the subject's clothing against a desaturated, high-key background.

letterConstructionRules: Slightly rounded corners on the bottom text
Extreme 3D extrusion for the background numerals
Distressed, grainy texture applied to the bottom lettering
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numerals feature a flat frontal face with a long, dark gray drop-shadow extrusion
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large 3D geometric numerals paired with weathered, wide-tracked condensed sans-serif.

preserve: Condensed nature of the bottom text
Wide letter spacing at the bottom
avoid: Clean, high-gloss finishes on the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure for the 3D effect.
Excellent for the bottom text due to its clean condensed uppercase forms.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a person with red hair in a white and red tracksuit walking across an asphalt lot in front of a gray corrugated metal garage door. Ensure the lighting is overcast and flat.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place large 3D extruded numerals in the upper right, behind the person's head. Add a distressed condensed sans-serif title at the bottom with wide tracking and a slight perspective tilt to match the ground.

verificationChecks: Is the red jacket the most saturated element?
Do the 3D numbers appear to be part of the background wall?
Is the bottom text grainy and slightly transparent?
Is the subject in a full-body walking profile?

adjustableVariables: Amount of grain on the bottom text
Height of the subject in frame
mustRedesign: Parental advisory logo must be replaced with a generic placeholder or removed
Specific facial features must be generalized
Unique tattoos must be replaced with generic patterns

mustAchieve: Authentic industrial texture on the wall
Balanced color distribution of red accents
avoid: Perfectly clean, digital-looking text at the bottom
Mismatched lighting between subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Check that the 3D extrusion direction is consistent
Ensure the bottom text tracking is wide enough to span the subject's stride
Verify that the red hair and red jacket are the same hue
Confirm the background wall texture is visible through the 3D numerals
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban photography + 3D background typography + Distressed footer text + Primary color pop (Red/White/Blue)
